title: Jr. CRO Specialist
skills: Test Execution & Support: Help build, QA, and launch A/B and multivariate tests across DTC and international storefronts, moving ideas from concept to live experiment quickly.

Reporting: Help compile test results and summarize what won, what lost, and what to do next in clear, non-technical language.

Brings fresh ideas and can think beyond common best practices.
Exposure to A/B testing tools (e.g., VWO, Optimizely, Convert, AB Tasty), Shopify, GA4, or heatmap/session tools (Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity).
Basic comfort with spreadsheets and simple statistics (sample size, significance).
Love of food and cooking is a plus, though not required to thrive in the role.

This is a full-time, long-term engagement with room to grow

description:
About the job

About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.

The Nigeria program, established in 2018, is headquartered in Minna, Niger state. We're currently serving over 100,000 unique farmers across the state via our inputs on credit 'Core' program, inputs on cash 'Retail' program, and have a free tree seedling distribution 'Agroforestry' program. To learn more about our work, look at our Nigeria program blog.

About The Role

This role ensures OAF Nigeria's expansion and business innovation agenda delivers on its 2030 ambition by identifying and validating new geographies and revenue opportunities, leading the end-to-end entry of new states from scouting through to operational handover, and building the commercial models that make each new market financially sustainable from day one.

Responsibilities

Strategy and Business Innovation


You will design OAF Nigeria's 5-year expansion and business innovation strategy, identifying new geographies, new revenue streams, and new commercial models that reduce dependence on any single income line and support the path to financial sustainability.
You will drive from strategy to a concrete annual plan — translating the long-term ambition into sequenced state entries, product and service trials, and business model validations with clear timelines and owners.


Expansion Execution


You will lead the end-to-end entry of new states — from security risk assessment and field scouting through site setup, stakeholder engagement, first-season farmer enrollment, and handover to the Regional Lead.
You will manage the expansion operations calendar, aligning scouting, SRA, state confirmation, infrastructure setup, and planting season windows so that no gate is missed and no entry is made without validated evidence.


People Management and Coaching


You will manage a team of four permanent staff, ensuring each person has clear goals, regular feedback, and a development path.
You will be a senior leader within the Programs Division, providing cross-departmental support through coaching and mentoring of mid-level staff, and helping to build the next generation of State Operations Leads and Regional Leads from within the expansion team.


Monitoring and Reporting


You will develop and track KPIs across all active expansion states and business innovation trials — including farmer enrollment rates, first-season repayment performance, gross margin per farmer, revenue per trial state, and new product uptake against target.
You will produce timely, actionable reports and communicate risks, progress, and go/no-go recommendations to the Head of Programs, Country Director, and Steerco — with the clarity and data quality expected of someone operating at the interface between field execution and organisational strategy.


Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, you will have:

We seek a professional with over 7 years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years leading cross-functional teams and working across multiple departments, combined with a passion for building commercially sustainable agricultural programmes that serve smallholder farmers.


Strategic thinking: Ability to translate a long-term ambition into a sequenced, evidence-based growth plan
Commercial acumen: Experience identifying, designing, and validating new revenue opportunities — products, services, or business models — in complex or resource-constrained environments
Project management: Ability to design, plan, and run multiple complex projects simultaneously to successful outcomes
Growth mindset: Enthusiasm for learning, feedback, and continuous improvement in the face of ambiguity
Results-oriented: You set goals, take ownership, and hold yourself and your team accountable for delivering them
Cross-functional fluency: You collaborate effectively with colleagues across programmes, finance, operations, and external partners
Strong educational background; minimum Bachelor's Degree, postgraduate qualification preferred
Willingness to be based in Minna, Niger State, with significant field travel across expansion states for periods of up to 18 months per assignment
English required; Hausa speaking strongly preferred


Preferred Start Date

As soon as possible

Job Location

Minna, Niger State, Nigeria - Onsite

Benefits

Health insurance, housing, and comprehensive benefits

Eligibility

This role is only open to citizens or permanent residents of Nigeria

Application Deadline

16th October, 2026. Please note that we hire on a rolling basis which means that applications are reviewed and processed on a continuous basis until a hire is made.

One Acre Fund never asks candidates to pay any money or pay for tests at any stage of the interview process. Official One Acre Fund emails will always arrive from an @oneacrefund.org address. Please report any suspicious communication here (globalhotline@oneacrefund.org), but do not send applications or application materials to this email address.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion (DEI), and anti-racism are deeply connected to our organization’s mission and purpose. One Acre Fund aspires to build a culture where all staff feel consistently valued, represented, and connected – so that our team can thrive as professionals, and achieve exceptional impact for the farmers we serve.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

About the job

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Senior Executive Search, GOC

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Executive Search who will:

description:
About the job

Antes de postularse para un puesto, seleccione su preferencia de idioma de las opciones disponibles en la parte superior derecha de esta página.

Si tiene las cualidades y el ímpetu para liderear equipos, hay posiciones listas para cultivar sus habilidades y llevarlo al siguiente nivel.

Descripción De Puesto

This role is essential to ensuring paid media campaigns are executed with precision and continuously improved through data-driven insights. By managing day-to-day campaign operations, supporting agency collaboration, and monitoring performance, the Advertising Specialist helps maintain campaign efficiency, identify opportunities for optimization, and contribute to overall demand generation success.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Planning

Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, sales, and product teams to develop paid media strategy and audience approach.

Research advertising trends and platform best practices to enhance strategic media planning.

Support creative development for paid media assets by developing creative briefs, reviewing assets, and ensuring creatives align with our brand guidelines.

Build and segment ideal customer profiles on paid media channels using platform targeting and audience lists.

Own the end-to-end tracking of new media launches from campaign development to execution.

Collaborate closely with Corporate, regional marketing and content teams to align on paid messaging roadmaps for new campaign launches.

Support ad copywriting development as needed.

Develop testing roadmaps and prioritize based on business goals and seasonality.

Campaign Execution & Management

Collaborate with website and media technology team to ensure accurate implementation of campaign tracking, tagging, and URL taxonomy for consistent attribution and measurement.

Ensure campaigns are trafficked accurately, including ad set-up, audience targeting, creative uploads, and tracking implementation.

Partner with media agency to ensure timely and organized campaign launches.

Lead weekly campaign status meetings with agency partners to review campaign updates, optimizations, and opportunities.

Monitor media spends pacing and invoicing/reconciliation against planned budgets.

Oversee campaign launches, documenting and communicating changes and updates to stakeholders.

Conduct pre and post launch QA to validate campaign set-up.

Drive operational excellence by enhancing processes, establishing clear timelines, and accountability with agency partners.

Manage multiple campaigns and priorities, ensuring work is organized, tracked, and timely.

Campaign Measurement

Monitor and analyze channel KPIs and performance trends, translating data into actionable insights and recommendations.

Maintain accurate documentation of key results to inform future campaign planning and execution.

Own development and maintenance of weekly and monthly paid media reporting.

Partner with media agency to leverage insights to optimize campaigns and scale performance.

Ensure measurement accuracy, validating data across reporting platforms.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

2–4 years of experience in paid media, digital marketing, or campaign execution, with hands-on responsibility for campaign launches and optimization.

Proven experience executing campaigns across search, social, and programmatic channels (e.g., Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, DV360 or similar platforms).

Strong working knowledge of campaign trafficking, tagging, and QA processes, including experience with tracking frameworks (e.g., UTM parameters, pixels, conversion tracking).

Experience collaborating with media agencies and cross-functional teams (demand generation, brand, web, analytics), with the ability to manage deliverables and timelines effectively.

Experience in campaign performance analysis and reporting, with the ability to interpret KPIs and translate data into actionable insights.

Strong understanding of funnel metrics and conversion performance (MQL → SQL → revenue), with an ability to identify optimization opportunities.

Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and execution.

Advanced English is required

Permanente

title: Paid Advertising Specialist
description:
About the job

Before you apply to a job, select your language preference from the options available at the top right of this page.

Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with talented teams that help you become better every day. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill + passion. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.

Job Description

This role is essential to ensuring paid media campaigns are executed with precision and continuously improved through data-driven insights. By managing day-to-day campaign operations, supporting agency collaboration, and monitoring performance, the Advertising Specialist helps maintain campaign efficiency, identify opportunities for optimization, and contribute to overall demand generation success.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Planning

Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, sales, and product teams to develop paid media strategy and audience approach.

Research advertising trends and platform best practices to enhance strategic media planning.

Support creative development for paid media assets by developing creative briefs, reviewing assets, and ensuring creatives align with our brand guidelines.

Build and segment ideal customer profiles on paid media channels using platform targeting and audience lists.

Own the end-to-end tracking of new media launches from campaign development to execution.

Collaborate closely with Corporate, regional marketing and content teams to align on paid messaging roadmaps for new campaign launches.

Support ad copywriting development as needed.

Develop testing roadmaps and prioritize based on business goals and seasonality.

Campaign Execution & Management

Collaborate with website and media technology team to ensure accurate implementation of campaign tracking, tagging, and URL taxonomy for consistent attribution and measurement.

Ensure campaigns are trafficked accurately, including ad set-up, audience targeting, creative uploads, and tracking implementation.

Partner with media agency to ensure timely and organized campaign launches.

Lead weekly campaign status meetings with agency partners to review campaign updates, optimizations, and opportunities.

Monitor media spends pacing and invoicing/reconciliation against planned budgets.

Oversee campaign launches, documenting and communicating changes and updates to stakeholders.

Conduct pre and post launch QA to validate campaign set-up.

Drive operational excellence by enhancing processes, establishing clear timelines, and accountability with agency partners.

Manage multiple campaigns and priorities, ensuring work is organized, tracked, and timely.

Campaign Measurement

Monitor and analyze channel KPIs and performance trends, translating data into actionable insights and recommendations.

Maintain accurate documentation of key results to inform future campaign planning and execution.

Own development and maintenance of weekly and monthly paid media reporting.

Partner with media agency to leverage insights to optimize campaigns and scale performance.

Ensure measurement accuracy, validating data across reporting platforms.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

2–4 years of experience in paid media, digital marketing, or campaign execution, with hands-on responsibility for campaign launches and optimization.

Proven experience executing campaigns across search, social, and programmatic channels (e.g., Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, DV360 or similar platforms).

Strong working knowledge of campaign trafficking, tagging, and QA processes, including experience with tracking frameworks (e.g., UTM parameters, pixels, conversion tracking).

Experience collaborating with media agencies and cross-functional teams (demand generation, brand, web, analytics), with the ability to manage deliverables and timelines effectively.

Experience in campaign performance analysis and reporting, with the ability to interpret KPIs and translate data into actionable insights.

Strong understanding of funnel metrics and conversion performance (MQL → SQL → revenue), with an ability to identify optimization opportunities.

Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and execution.

Advanced English is required

Employee Type

Permanent

UPS is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

description:
About the job

COMPENSACIÓN — MÉXICO

USD $2,300 – 3,000 / mes

Pagado en USD contra factura. Rango por encima del tope del mercado local colombiano.




𝗨𝗻 𝗽𝘂𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼, 𝗱𝗼𝘀 𝗳𝘂𝗻𝗰𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗲𝘀

Queremos ser claros desde el anuncio: este rol combina dos posiciones que normalmente están separadas. Buscamos a una sola persona que haga las dos cosas.




✓ M̲e̲d̲i̲a̲ ̲B̲u̲y̲e̲r̲ — compras y optimizas las campañas pagadas. Eres responsable del presupuesto, del CPA y del ROAS.




✓ ̲M̲a̲r̲k̲e̲t̲i̲n̲g̲-̲O̲p̲s̲ ̲A̲n̲a̲l̲y̲s̲t̲ — eres dueño de la infraestructura de medición. GA4, Google Tag Manager, tracking de conversiones, píxeles, UTMs, la integración con el CRM y la atribución across todas nuestras marcas.




📌 𝙎𝙞 𝙨𝙤𝙡𝙤 𝙝𝙖𝙨 𝙝𝙚𝙘𝙝𝙤 𝙪𝙣𝙖 𝙙𝙚 𝙡𝙖𝙨 𝙙𝙤𝙨, 𝙚𝙨𝙩𝙚 𝙥𝙪𝙚𝙨𝙩𝙤 𝙣𝙤 𝙚𝙨 𝙥𝙖𝙧𝙖 𝙩𝙞.

🔥 Si has hecho las dos y te gusta que el número que reportas sea un número que tú mismo construiste, sigue leyendo.🔥 




𝗤𝘂𝗶é𝗻𝗲𝘀 𝘀𝗼𝗺𝗼𝘀

Kavren Technologies es una empresa estadounidense que opera un portafolio de marcas en salud y bienestar: una plataforma nacional de telesalud, una clínica de atención primaria en Miami, cirugía plástica y estética, y más. Cinco dominios, presupuestos activos en Meta y Google, y hoy nadie es dueño del número.

🚀 Eso es lo que vienes a resolver.🚀




⭐ 𝗤𝘂é 𝘃𝗮𝘀 𝗮 𝗵𝗮𝗰𝗲𝗿 — 𝗠𝗲𝗱𝗶𝗮 𝗕𝘂𝘆𝗶𝗻𝗴

• Planear, ejecutar y optimizar campañas pagadas en Meta Ads y Google Ads across el portafolio

• Gestionar el presupuesto con responsabilidad directa sobre CPA, CAC y ROAS

• Definir la estrategia de audiencias, pruebas y rotación creativa

• Trabajar con el equipo creativo para especificar qué piezas se necesitan y cuáles están funcionando

• Manejar las restricciones de la categoría de salud en Meta sin que se bloqueen las cuentas




⭐ 𝗤𝘂é 𝘃𝗮𝘀 𝗮 𝗵𝗮𝗰𝗲𝗿 — 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗲𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗢𝗽𝘀

• Ser dueño de GA4 y Google Tag Manager a nivel de implementación, no solo de lectura

• Construir y mantener el tracking de conversiones, píxeles y disciplina de UTMs en todas las marcas

• Integrar y mantener la conexión con el CRM (GoHighLevel, Nexuite) para que el lead se pueda seguir de punta a punta

• Construir el modelo de atribución: de dónde vienen los pacientes y cuánto cuesta cada uno, de verdad

• Mantener la capa de reporte de la que jala todo el equipo — una sola fuente de verdad

• Reportar semanalmente con números, no con impresiones




𝗤𝘂é 𝗻𝗲𝗰𝗲𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘀

✓ 3+ años comprando medios con presupuesto propio. Vamos a pedirte los números: gasto gestionado, CPA, ROAS

✓ Dominio real de Meta Ads Manager y Google Ads — ejecución diaria, no supervisión

✓ GA4 y GTM a nivel de implementación: eventos, conversiones, capa de datos

✓ Experiencia integrando un CRM con plataformas publicitarias

✓ Hojas de cálculo a nivel avanzado. SQL suma mucho

✓ Criterio analítico real: explicar por qué una campaña funciona o no, no solo reportar que funcionó

✓ Español nativo. Inglés a nivel de lectura técnica

✓ Disponibilidad durante el horario laboral del Este de EE. UU. para videollamadas

✓ Experiencia Medica en los EEUU.




✅ 𝗦𝘂𝗺𝗮 𝗺𝘂𝗰𝗵𝗼

→ Experiencia con la categoría restringida de salud en Meta. Las cuentas de salud se bloquean constantemente y necesitamos a alguien que ya haya vivido eso

→ Experiencia en salud, estética, telesalud o industrias reguladas

→ Haber trabajado con varias marcas al mismo tiempo, no con una sola cuenta

→ Experiencia con el mercado hispano de Estados Unidos




🤝 𝗤𝘂é 𝗼𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗲𝗺𝗼𝘀

✓ Honorarios mensuales en USD, pagados contra factura

Tarifa en el rango más alto del mercado local. Pagamos bien y esperamos el resultado que eso implica

✓ Propiedad real: hoy nadie tiene este rol. Lo construyes tú desde cero y las decisiones son tuyas

✓ Una métrica clara. Vas a saber exactamente cómo se mide tu trabajo

✓ Varias marcas, varios presupuestos, y suficiente volumen para que el trabajo sea interesante




🎯 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝗮 𝗮𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗿

Mándanos dos cosas. En corto — no queremos una carta de presentación.

𝟭. 𝗘𝗻 𝘁𝗿𝗲𝘀 𝗳𝗿𝗮𝘀𝗲𝘀: una cuenta que manejaste, cuánto presupuesto mensual, y el CPA antes y después de que la tomaras.

𝟮. 𝗗𝗲𝘀𝗰𝗿𝗶𝗯𝗲 un sistema de tracking o atribución que hayas construido desde cero, 𝘆 𝗾𝘂é 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗯𝗹𝗲𝗺𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝗹𝘃𝗶ó.

Contamos con operaciones de CEDIS y servicios transfronterizos en Laredo, Texas, junto con apoyo en resolución de problemas aduaneros y cumplimiento normativo. También impulsamos soluciones de e-commerce, entrada a nuevos mercados y programas para vender en México dirigidos a empresas internacionales. Desde el origen y la compra hasta el despacho aduanero y la entrega final en México, integramos toda la operación internacional bajo un único socio estratégico.
Descripción del puesto En el puesto de Freelance Mkt digital (TikTok) colaborarás con el equipo de SPD Customs & Trade en el diseño y ejecución de campañas de marketing digital centradas en TikTok para dar a conocer nuestros servicios de comercio internacional. En tu día a día crearás contenido en vídeo, adaptarás mensajes para distintos segmentos de audiencia, gestionarás el calendario de publicaciones y analizarás el rendimiento de las campañas para proponer mejoras. Aptitudes en marketing digital y estrategia digital, con experiencia creando campañas y contenido específico para TikTok u otras plataformas de vídeo corto.

Aptitudes de comunicación para redactar mensajes claros, adaptarte a distintos públicos y colaborar con equipos internos y clientes internacionales.

description:
About the job

Community Manager – Mexico

Location: Mexico City, Mexico

Brand: Infinix

Function: Marketing / User Operations

Position: Community Manager




Job Overview

We are looking for a proactive and creative Community Manager to support the growth and daily operations of Infinix’s user community in Mexico.

This role will be responsible for growing and activating our online communities, managing KOC/KOS creator programs, developing engaging local content, supporting offline activations, and strengthening the connection between the Infinix brand and local users.

The ideal candidate understands Mexican social media culture, enjoys interacting with users and creators, and is comfortable managing both daily community operations and project-based campaigns.




Key Responsibilities

1. Community Growth & Operations

Manage and grow Infinix Mexico’s user communities across platforms such as Facebook Groups, WhatsApp, TikTok, Instagram and other relevant channels.
Develop initiatives to continuously recruit new community members and improve user activation and retention.
Maintain daily interaction with community members, including comments, discussions, polls, challenges and user-generated content.
Identify highly engaged users and develop them into core community members, brand advocates or Fan Hosts.
Monitor community sentiment, feedback and user needs, and regularly provide VOC (Voice of Customer) insights to internal teams.
Maintain a healthy, active and positive community environment.

2. KOC & Creator Management

Recruit and manage local KOCs (Key Opinion Customers), micro-creators and brand advocates.
Build and maintain an updated creator database, including creator profiles, content performance and activity status.
Develop creator segmentation and tiering systems based on content quality, activity and performance.
Provide KOCs with campaign briefs, product information, content inspiration and execution guidance.
Follow up on creator content delivery and ensure content meets campaign and brand requirements.
Identify high-potential KOCs and support their development into stronger creators or KOL-level partners.

3. KOS Program Support

Support the development and daily operation of Infinix Mexico’s KOS (Key Opinion Sales) program.
Work closely with Retail and Sales teams to recruit and activate store promoters or retail staff as content creators.
Provide simple content training, shooting guidelines, scripts and creative references for KOS participants.
Track KOS content output, follower growth, engagement and overall performance.
Support incentive programs, monthly rankings, recognition programs and creator challenges.
Help connect online content creation with offline retail traffic and sales conversion.

4. Campaigns & Offline Activations

Support local community campaigns, product launches, gaming activations, campus activities and offline user events.
Design online-to-offline engagement mechanisms to attract community members and creators.
Coordinate participant recruitment, event communication and post-event follow-up.
Support merchandise, prizes and incentive distribution when required.
Collaborate with internal Marketing, Retail, Sales and agency partners to ensure smooth execution.

5. Data Tracking & Reporting

Track key community and creator KPIs, including: community member growth, active users and engagement rate, KOC/KOS recruitment, content output, campaign participation.
Prepare weekly community reports.
Identify challenges and propose actionable solutions based on performance data.




Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, Business or a related field.
3+ years of experience in community management, social media, influencer marketing, creator operations or digital marketing.
Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp.
Good knowledge of Mexican social media trends, internet culture and local consumer behavior.
Experience managing influencers, KOCs, creators or online communities is highly preferred.
Experience in smartphones, consumer electronics, gaming, youth culture or lifestyle brands is a plus.
Strong communication, organization and project management skills.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced and multicultural environment.
Native or fluent Spanish required.
Working proficiency in English is preferred.




Preferred Profile

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

Are highly active on social media and naturally understand online trends.
Enjoy building relationships with users and creators.
Can independently identify problems and drive execution.
Are creative but also data-driven.
Have experience building communities from scratch or significantly growing an existing community.
Are comfortable communicating with retail promoters, creators, agencies and internal stakeholders.
Are willing to participate in occasional offline events or activations.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
About the job

Sobre CUBBO




Somos CUBBO, una empresa respaldada por venture capital que construye la infraestructura del ecommerce; combinando tecnología y logística para que las marcas escalen el comercio moderno.

Apoyamos a las marcas conectando todo su proceso de pedidos —desde la compra hasta la entrega— a través de tecnología y operaciones.




Nuestra plataforma atiende a cientos de marcas y procesa +1M de pedidos mensuales, entregando con velocidad y consistencia.




Trabajamos desde la Ciudad de México, donde nuestro equipo construye herramientas y capacidades logísticas para el comercio moderno.




Nuestra Visión




Empoderar a las marcas para que ganen libertad, convirtiéndonos en la plataforma presente en cada transacción del comercio moderno.

No estamos aquí solo para competir; estamos aquí para dominar y redefinir el futuro del comercio moderno. Si eres un jugador AAA, CUBBO te ofrece una plataforma sin igual para ser parte de esta transformación.




Nuestra Misión




Ayudamos al comercio moderno a reducir fricción y entregar mejores experiencias de compra. Nuestra plataforma conecta todo el proceso de pedidos —desde la compra hasta la entrega— a través de tecnología, operaciones y logística.




Ubicación




Ciudad de México (Headquarters)

Modelo híbrido: 4 días presencial, 1 día remoto

Sí, no somos 100% remotos.




El Rol




En Cubbo operamos varias líneas de negocio con objetivos y necesidades propias a nivel de comunicación y marketing.

Como Product Marketing Manager, serás la persona que asuma la responsabilidad de una vertical y la comprenda a fondo —producto, cliente, motivos de compra y de rechazo— para traducir ese conocimiento en demanda: posicionar a Cubbo en su mercado, dotar al equipo comercial de argumentos sólidos y asegurar que las prioridades de marketing respondan a los objetivos del negocio.




Responsabilidades Clave




Mercado, Posicionamiento y Mensaje:

• Ser el experto en tu vertical: quién compra, por qué compra, qué lo detiene y contra qué nos comparan.

• Definir y mantener vivos el ICP, las buyer personas y los casos de uso prioritarios.

• Construir el posicionamiento, la propuesta de valor y el messaging de la vertical, y asegurar que se use igual en web, campañas, ventas y contenido.

• Levantar inteligencia competitiva y de mercado de forma continua, no como un ejercicio anual.

• Pasar tiempo real con clientes y con el equipo comercial: llamadas, deals perdidos, onboarding, visitas a almacén.




Go-to-Market y Ejecución:

• Diseñar y ejecutar el plan de marketing de tu vertical, alineado al objetivo de revenue del trimestre.

• Operar las campañas de paid de tu BU: definir audiencia, oferta y mensaje, y revisar performance con la agencia.

• Producir contenido comercial de tu vertical y alimentar el calendario editorial central con ángulos, ideas y piezas.

• Entregar los insumos de SEO y PR de tu BU: keywords comerciales, objeciones reales, historias que valgan la pena contarse.

• Liderar los lanzamientos: qué se anuncia, a quién, con qué narrativa y con qué material de soporte.

• Escribir los briefs de landing pages, campañas y piezas que ejecute el equipo central o las agencias.




Ventas, Pipeline y Negocio:

• Ser el socio de Marketing del líder comercial de tu vertical: traducir el número en un plan de generación de demanda.

• Construir el material que Ventas necesita: decks, one-pagers, battlecards, respuestas a objeciones, casos de éxito.

• Analizar el embudo de tu BU: de dónde vienen los leads, dónde se caen, qué mensajes convierten y cuáles no.

• Traer de vuelta al equipo de Marketing lo que aprendes en el campo, para que el sistema mejore y no solo tu vertical.

• Priorizar: decidir qué hace Marketing por tu BU este trimestre y defender esa decisión con datos.




Habilidades y Competencias




• Mentalidad de Ownership, tomando total responsabilidad por el éxito o fracaso de un lanzamiento.

• Agilidad para adaptarse a un entorno de startup que procesa millones de órdenes y cambia constantemente.

• Pensamiento estratégico equilibrado con una ejecución impecable en los detalles.




Hard Skills




• 1 a 4 años en Product Marketing, Growth, Marketing B2B, marketing comercial o estrategia.

• Estructurar y comunicar ideas efectivamente para landing pages, contenido comercial, material de ventas.

• Manejo práctico de campañas de paid (Google, Meta, LinkedIn): saber leer el performance y decidir qué cambiar.

• Uso fluido de IA para producir texto, diseño, investigación, análisis. No es un plus, es parte del trabajo.

• Cómodo con datos y CRM (HubSpot o similar): leer el embudo, entender de dónde viene el pipeline y crear estrategias para mejorar.




Deseable




• Experiencia previa en el sector de ecommerce, logística tecnológica o fintech.

• Conocimiento profundo del ecosistema de Shopify, VTEX o plataformas similares.

• Experiencia trabajando en startups de alto crecimiento con rondas de inversión Serie A en adelante.

• Experiencia previa trabajando con agencias de paid, SEO o PR.




Nuestros Valores




Customer First: En CUBBO, el cliente es nuestra estrella norte. Operamos bajo el principio de que la mejor decisión para nuestros clientes es la mejor decisión para nosotros.




Confianza: Confías en tus compañeros Cubbeños, reconociendo que el trabajo en equipo es esencial para nuestro éxito colectivo.




Empoderamiento: En CUBBO, esperar instrucciones no es opción. Eres un catalizador que empodera a otros a tomar la iniciativa y tomar decisiones de impacto.




Growth Mindset: Siempre estás haciendo preguntas, con hambre de mejorar. Si no te da pena lo que hacías hace seis meses, no estás creciendo lo suficientemente rápido.




Velocidad: Las ideas solas no ganan mercados; la ejecución rápida y efectiva sí. Actuamos rápido, nos adaptamos y convertimos planes en resultados.




Candor: La transparencia y el feedback constructivo son la base de nuestra cultura. Valoramos la honestidad orientada al crecimiento personal y profesional.




¿Por qué unirte a CUBBO?

Sé parte de una revolución

Únete a nosotros para establecer estándares disruptivos en la industria y cambiar la cara del ecommerce en Latinoamérica. Estamos revolucionando la región entera a través de la innovación.




Trabaja con los mejores

Acelera tu crecimiento profesional exponencialmente en CUBBO. Un año aquí equivale a una década de experiencia en otro lugar. Si eres un high-performer que busca un equipo de campeones, tu búsqueda termina aquí.




Construido para durar, construido para ganar

No solo sobrevivimos; estamos creciendo. Nuestra salud financiera nos permite enfocarnos en lo que realmente importa: ganar el mercado y asegurar una experiencia al cliente sin igual.




Salario




• MXN 40000 bruto mensual

• Crecimiento profesional: oportunidades aceleradas de aprendizaje y desarrollo en una empresa de rápido crecimiento

• Excelente ambiente laboral: trabaja con un equipo inspirador y divertido en una cultura que valora la colaboración, el crecimiento y la mentalidad customer-first

• Estar en la primera fila transformando toda la industria del Comercio Moderno

• 20 días de vacaciones desde el día 1

• Servicio / Comedor en la oficina

• Seguro médico

About the job

Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission 

We are seeking an exceptional Senior Engineering Manager to join our growing Cloud Native Applications team and lead delivery on Caylent's largest and most strategically important client engagements. title: Head of Growth Design
skills: Un caso de tu portafolio: qué estaba roto, qué cambiaste, qué número se movió, y en cuánto tiempo.

Responde esto en un párrafo, en español: una mujer de 38 años busca tratamiento para bajar de peso. Le da vergüenza. Llega a nuestra página desde un anuncio en Instagram. ¿Cómo diseñas las primeras tres pantallas para que no abandone, y por qué funciona cada decisión que tomaste?
description:
About the job

Kavren Technologies · Remoto · Contratista independiente · Tiempo completo




Somos una empresa estadounidense de tecnología en salud. Operamos una plataforma nacional de telesalud y una clínica de atención primaria en Miami.




Buscamos a la persona que va a ser dueña de la experiencia completa del usuario: desde que ve el anuncio hasta que termina su primera consulta.




Este no es un puesto de diseño visual. Es un puesto de psicología aplicada.




EL PROBLEMA REAL QUE VAS A RESOLVER




Nuestros pacientes buscan tratamientos para control de peso, terapia hormonal y salud sexual. La mayoría llega con vergüenza.




No abandonan por el precio. Abandonan porque el formulario los hace sentir expuestos, porque no saben si pueden confiar en nosotros, o porque les pedimos demasiado antes de darles algo a cambio.




Resolver eso es el trabajo. No es hacer que las pantallas se vean mejor.




QUÉ VAS A HACER




• Ser dueño del recorrido completo: página de aterrizaje, registro, admisión médica, selección de tratamiento y checkout

• Rediseñar el flujo de admisión para reducir el abandono, sabiendo que las preguntas médicas son obligatorias y no se pueden eliminar

• Escribir el texto, no solo los wireframes. En este puesto las palabras son la experiencia

• Construir la experiencia en español para el mercado hispano de Estados Unidos. Hoy no hay un solo competidor directo en la primera página de búsqueda en español

• Definir la arquitectura de confianza: credenciales médicas, proveedores con licencia, qué pasa si el tratamiento no funciona, cómo se cancela

• Estudiar la experiencia de nuestros competidores a fondo y construir una mejor, punto por punto

• Priorizar qué se arregla primero según impacto, y defender esa prioridad con un argumento




QUÉ NECESITAS




• 6+ años en diseño de producto o experiencia digital, con al menos dos enfocados en conversión

• Portafolio con números. Antes, después, y la métrica que se movió. Los portafolios que solo muestran pantallas no se revisan

• Capacidad de escribir. Texto de conversión, no descripciones de funcionalidades

• Entender por qué funciona un cambio, no solo que funcionó. Te vamos a preguntar el porqué

• Usar herramientas de IA en tu flujo de trabajo, y saber dónde no sirven

• Español nativo

• Inglés suficiente para trabajar con el equipo y leer documentación técnica

• Disponibilidad durante el horario laboral del Este de Estados Unidos para videollamadas




SUMA, PERO NO ES OBLIGATORIO




• Experiencia en salud, farmacéutica, seguros o cualquier industria regulada

• Experiencia con productos de suscripción

• Experiencia diseñando para categorías sensibles o estigmatizadas

• Manejo de herramientas de análisis de comportamiento y grabación de sesiones




DÓNDE ENCAJA EL PUESTO




Reportas al Director de Marketing y trabajas directamente con el equipo de desarrollo. Hay capacidad de ingeniería asignada, no vas a esperar meses por un cambio.




QUÉ OFRECEMOS




• USD $3,300 - $4,100 mensuales, pagados contra factura

• Tarifa en el rango más alto del mercado regional. Pagamos bien y esperamos el resultado que eso implica

• Propiedad real: eres la primera contratación de este puesto, no la quinta

• Una plataforma que todavía no está optimizada. El margen de mejora es enorme y se ve de inmediato

• Decisiones rápidas. No hay comité




PARA APLICAR




Dos cosas. Las dos son parte de la evaluación.




Un caso de tu portafolio: qué estaba roto, qué cambiaste, qué número se movió, y en cuánto tiempo.
Responde esto en un párrafo, en español: una mujer de 38 años busca tratamiento para bajar de peso. Le da vergüenza. Llega a nuestra página desde un anuncio en Instagram. ¿Cómo diseñas las primeras tres pantallas para que no abandone, y por qué funciona cada decisión que tomaste?

No buscamos la respuesta correcta. Buscamos cómo piensas.




Las postulaciones sin el caso con números no serán revisadas.

About Amply

Amply is a digital design and development agency partnering with B2B SaaS, healthcare and fintech companies to build brands and digital experiences that drive growth. We take craft seriously, invest in our people, and believe great work comes from great culture.




About the role

We’re looking for a senior web designer who can own projects end to end, from brief and creative direction through design system, execution and developer handoff.




The role has changed a lot in the last year. We’ve always built exceptional Webflow sites, and we still do, but we’re increasingly working as a strategic partner to marketing leaders, and AI is reshaping how sites get designed, built and improved. Our projects are increasingly platform agnostic. The designers who do well here bring strong judgment and taste, use AI fluently as part of their process, and are curious about where this is heading rather than attached to how it used to work.




You’ll work across both project-based engagements and long-term client accounts, alongside design leads, project managers and our development team. It suits someone who enjoys ownership, thinks about the business goal behind every brief, and holds themselves to a high standard.

Who we’re looking for

This role isn’t suitable for junior or mid-level candidates. We’re looking for someone who already operates at a senior level and can own a project’s design outcome independently.

Conversation with the Head of Design.

Fully remote.

We’re also a highly organised company, so if you have a genuine passion for structure you’ll feel at home. We’re not a family, we’re a team working towards the same goal.

description:
About the job

Title: Customer Success Manager

Location: Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY

At Salesloft, our Customer Success Managers own the relationship that determines whether a customer renews, expands, and becomes an advocate — or quietly churns. You are the person accountable for making sure customers realize measurable value from our Predictive Revenue System, translating platform capability into revenue outcomes their leadership can see.

This is not a reactive support role. You will manage a book of business proactively — using product usage data, AI-surfaced health signals, and your own commercial judgment to intervene before problems become risks and to spot expansion opportunities before the customer asks. You will be the voice of the customer inside Salesloft and the trusted advisor the customer relies on outside it.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:


Own retention, adoption, and net revenue expansion across a defined book of business, translating each customer's goals into a clear plan for realizing value from the platform.
Use AI-surfaced customer health signals, product usage data, and engagement scoring to prioritize proactively — acting first on the accounts and moments that matter most.
Lead strategic business reviews with customer stakeholders and executives, connecting platform usage to measurable revenue outcomes and ROI.
Partner with Account Management to identify and drive expansion opportunities grounded in demonstrated value.
Advocate for customers cross-functionally — bringing structured product feedback to Product and Engineering and coordinating internal resources to resolve challenges.
Drive adoption through tailored enablement, onboarding support, and ongoing strategic guidance that keeps customers progressing toward their goals.


This role lives at the heart of how we are Customer Inspired: every action you take is measured against a single question — does this make our customer more successful? And in the spirit of how we Lead From the Front, you'll use the same AI-powered platform our customers use, bringing applied curiosity to how technology can scale the value you deliver across your entire book.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a commercially minded relationship builder who understands that customer success is a revenue discipline, not a support function. You are equally comfortable running an executive business review and digging into usage data to find the signal that tells you where to focus next.

You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — you bring data to customer conversations rather than assumption, you let health signals and outcomes guide where you spend your time, and you're honest with customers about what will and won't move them forward. You are proactive by nature, energized by ownership, and motivated by seeing customers win.

This is the right role if you want to own real commercial outcomes at a company whose platform is redefining how revenue teams operate.

THE TEAM

The Salesloft Customer Success organization is responsible for the retention, adoption, and growth of our customer base — the team that ensures the value we sell is the value customers actually realize. CSMs here operate as trusted advisors and commercial owners, working closely with Account Management, Support, Product, and Marketing.

The team Moves as One — success, sales, and support operate with shared ownership of customer outcomes, surfacing risks and opportunities directly rather than passing them between functions. And we are relentlessly Customer Inspired: the entire team measures itself by customer success, not internal activity metrics, because a renewed and expanding customer is the only result that counts.

THE SKILL SET


Proven track record in a Customer Success, Account Management, or post-sale role at a B2B SaaS company, with direct ownership of retention and expansion outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to manage a book of business and consistently meet or exceed retention and net revenue expansion targets.
Comfort working with product usage data and customer health signals to prioritize action and drive decisions.
Strong executive presence — the ability to run business reviews and build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to translate platform capability into business outcomes a customer's leadership will value.
Experience with a sales engagement, revenue intelligence, or revenue operations platform — Salesloft, Clari, Gong, Outreach, or adjacent tools.
Familiarity using AI-driven customer health scoring, engagement analytics, or predictive churn signals to manage a book of business.
Experience partnering closely with Account Management on expansion in a shared-account model.


BENEFITS:

For more information about our company's comprehensive benefits please visit: https://salesloftbenefits.com/

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

______________________________________________________________________________________________

Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from a @ salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Clari + Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers site.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. About the job

About the Company




Founded in 1950, Westfield FC has been an important part of its local football community for more than 75 years. Today, the club competes in the 8th tier of English football and is backed by an ambitious group of investors committed to building a sustainable, community-driven club with long-term growth potential. Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.




Company Website: https://www.westfield-fc.com/




About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors




Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.




We are also actively seeking advisors from Mexico to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.




Key Responsibilities




Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network.
Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships.
Provide strategic guidance on club growth, marketing, fundraising, commercial partnerships, and community engagement.
Support revenue-generating and brand-building initiatives when appropriate.

Passion for football and the business of sports.
Experience as an executive, entrepreneur, investor, advisor, or business leader.
Strong professional network that can support club growth.
Interest in sports investing, football operations, sponsorships, or community development.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.




Compensation & Benefits




This advisory role offers sweat equity aligned with advisor contributions and the long-term success of Westfield FC. Advisors will have the opportunity to help shape the strategic direction of the club, work alongside the ownership group, expand their network within the football industry, and participate in an exciting football investment journey.




Why Join Us




Join an ambitious ownership group building a historic football club with a bold long-term vision. Inspired by stories like Welcome to Wrexham, our goal is to build a sustainable, community-focused club capable of climbing the English football pyramid and ultimately reaching the English Football League. If you’ve ever wanted to help shape the future of a football club from the inside while sharing in its long-term success, this is a unique opportunity.




Equal Opportunity Statement




Westfield FC is an equal opportunity organization. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and respectful environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Clinical Engagement Lead - Mexico
skills: Build and manage a portfolio of region/country investigator and clinical site relationships in the I&I therapeutic area — identifying, engaging, and developing long-term partnerships with principal investigators, academic medical centers, community research sites, and subspecialty practices relevant to Beeline's clinical programs.

Lead site identification and feasibility activities for clinical trials — conducting operational site assessments, evaluating investigator interest and patient population access, and providing strategic recommendations to Clinical Development and Clinical Operations on site selection and activation.

Serve as the primary clinical liaison to regional/country level investigators — facilitating peer-to-peer scientific exchange on Beeline's pipeline, conducting protocol discussions, supporting site initiation and training, and maintaining ongoing engagement with investigators throughout the trial lifecycle.

Support clinical trial enrollment and retention at region/country sites — working proactively with investigators and site staff to identify enrollment challenges, implement site-level solutions, and maintain site motivation and engagement across all active Beeline studies.

Capture and communicate region/country clinical landscape intelligence — including investigator perspectives, competitive trial activity, site capacity trends, and unmet medical need insights — back to Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, and Commercial teams in a structured, actionable manner.

Partner with Medical Affairs MSLs to ensure coordination and alignment of scientific engagement activities at the investigator level — establishing clear boundaries between clinical trial support and medical affairs activities and collaborating to maximize the impact of both.

Represent organization clinical and scientific meetings, investigator symposia, disease-area conferences, and site visits — engaging with the clinical research community as a credible, knowledgeable, and trusted organizational representative.
Develop and implement site engagement strategies to improve study start-up, enrollment performance, retention, and site satisfaction.
Partner closely with investigators, study coordinators, and site staff to support patient identification and recruitment efforts.
Provide operational guidance and best practices to sites related to diverse patient enrollment and community engagement.
Conduct regular field engagement with investigative sites and community stakeholders to strengthen study execution and recruitment performance.
Monitor enrollment trends, site performance metrics, and patient engagement effectiveness using data-driven approaches.
Identify enrollment risks proactively and implement mitigation and recovery plans.
Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.
Education: Bachelors degree in scientific or related discipline required. Advanced degree preferred—MS or MPH in a relevant clinical, biomedical, or pharmaceutical sciences discipline.
8+ years of experience in clinical development, clinical research, clinical operations, or a field-based clinical engagement role within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.
Demonstrated experience managing investigator relationships and supporting clinical trial site activation and enrollment.
Experience in immunology, inflammation, or a related therapeutic area strongly preferred.
Experience collaborating with CROs, investigative sites, and field medical teams, including MSL partnerships.

Strong scientific and clinical knowledge of immunology and inflammation — including disease biology, standard of care, clinical trial design considerations, and the competitive clinical research landscape across relevant I&I indications.

Expertise in clinical trial site management and investigator engagement — including site feasibility assessment, investigator identification and qualification, site initiation support, and enrollment optimization strategies.

description:
About the job

About Beeline Medicines

Beeline Medicines is a clinical‑stage biotechnology company focused on developing and delivering category-leading precision therapies to transform the lives of people living with autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. With a portfolio of potential best-in-class and first-in-disease therapeutic candidates that directly target key pathways governing dysregulated immunological and inflammatory responses, the Company is developing medicines that have the opportunity to provide durable, life-changing impact. Led by an established executive team and backed by world-class life science investors, each day Beeline Medicines is determined to bring the scientific rigor and operational excellence to get to what matters for patients – realizing a world where people with immune-mediated diseases can live life fully.

Job Summary

The Clinical Engagement Lead, is a field-based is a senior level, site facing clinical development professional responsible for building and managing investigator and site relationships across the globe in support of the organization's clinical trial portfolio. This role serves as the primary site-facing liaison between the organization and its global clinical investigators, academic medical centers, and research sites — supporting site identification, investigator engagement, and clinical trial execution to position the organization’s I&I programs competitively in the clinical research landscape. The Clinical Engagement Lead combines knowledge of the I&I therapeutic area with strong relationship management skills and a thorough understanding of clinical trial operations — serving as a trusted partner to investigators and a critical field intelligence link back to the internal Clinical Development and Medical Affairs teams. This is a highly visible, externally focused role that requires the ability to represent the organization’s science with authority, build lasting relationships with leading clinical researchers, and operate independently across a broad assigned geography.

Work Arrangement & Location:

Field-Based - This position is field-based, and the incumbent will be expected to work within their assigned territory or region on behalf of the company. Regular travel within the designated geography is an inherent requirement of this role. Additional travel outside of the assigned territory may be required based on business need, including attendance at company meetings, training, or other organizational events.

Territory Assignment Notice

Mexico and other LATAM countries as assigned.

Notice: The geographic territory outlined for this position reflects current business needs and is subject to change at the discretion of the organization. Territory boundaries, state assignments, and regional alignments may be modified at any time based on evolving business priorities, organizational restructuring, or strategic initiatives. The selected candidate will be expected to adapt to any such changes as a condition of employment.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities


Build and manage a portfolio of region/country investigator and clinical site relationships in the I&I therapeutic area — identifying, engaging, and developing long-term partnerships with principal investigators, academic medical centers, community research sites, and subspecialty practices relevant to Beeline's clinical programs.
Lead site identification and feasibility activities for clinical trials — conducting operational site assessments, evaluating investigator interest and patient population access, and providing strategic recommendations to Clinical Development and Clinical Operations on site selection and activation.
Serve as the primary clinical liaison to regional/country level investigators — facilitating peer-to-peer scientific exchange on Beeline's pipeline, conducting protocol discussions, supporting site initiation and training, and maintaining ongoing engagement with investigators throughout the trial lifecycle.
Support clinical trial enrollment and retention at region/country sites — working proactively with investigators and site staff to identify enrollment challenges, implement site-level solutions, and maintain site motivation and engagement across all active Beeline studies.
Capture and communicate region/country clinical landscape intelligence — including investigator perspectives, competitive trial activity, site capacity trends, and unmet medical need insights — back to Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, and Commercial teams in a structured, actionable manner.
Partner with Medical Affairs MSLs to ensure coordination and alignment of scientific engagement activities at the investigator level — establishing clear boundaries between clinical trial support and medical affairs activities and collaborating to maximize the impact of both.
Represent organization clinical and scientific meetings, investigator symposia, disease-area conferences, and site visits — engaging with the clinical research community as a credible, knowledgeable, and trusted organizational representative.
Develop and implement site engagement strategies to improve study start-up, enrollment performance, retention, and site satisfaction.
Partner closely with investigators, study coordinators, and site staff to support patient identification and recruitment efforts.

Conduct regular field engagement with investigative sites and community stakeholders to strengthen study execution and recruitment performance.

Identify enrollment risks proactively and implement mitigation and recovery plans.
Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

8+ years of experience in clinical development, clinical research, clinical operations, or a field-based clinical engagement role within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.
Demonstrated experience managing investigator relationships and supporting clinical trial site activation and enrollment.
Experience in immunology, inflammation, or a related therapeutic area strongly preferred.
Experience collaborating with CROs, investigative sites, and field medical teams, including MSL partnerships.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

This role will own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for key fraud projects. You will work closely with Engineering, Legal, Finance, Risk, and external vendors to design and launch secure, compliant fraud systems that enable Kraken to operate across jurisdictions while protecting users from fraud and supporting investigations—without disrupting legitimate client activity. As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.


Please share your resume in English.


Responsibilities:


Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements


A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
Fluent communication skills English.
Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Benefits


You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

SIG competencies

We are looking for people who are willing to consistently achieve results, even under tough circumstances, employees who create a climate where everyone is motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives. If you actively seek new ways to grow and be challenged, if you develop people to meet both their career goals and the organization's goals, SIG is the place for you. To deliver better for our customers, our future colleagues build strong customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions. Finally, we are looking for colleagues who build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. Are you someone who applies knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization's goals? Are you someone who can create new and better ways for the organization to be successful? If the answer is 'yes', come and join us.

Our promise

SIG is the place for you to build something incredible. We offer competitive compensation and an opportunity to partially work from home. If you join us, you will be part of a globally successful international company, which is leading its industry in sustainability, technology, and more. We think of ourselves as the career launchpad - a place to develop yourself fast with real work, real experience, real opportunities to build skills. Sustainability guides us, technology empowers us, but it's the passion and drive of our people that truly enable us to deliver better. Founded in 1853, SIG is headquartered in Neuhausen, Switzerland, and listed at the SIX Swiss Exchange.

About the job

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are… 

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Your New Role:
We are searching for an Senior Specialist Employee Services to join the Global Business Services (GBS) People & Culture (P&C) team. In this role, the Senior Specialist provides efficient and highly informative first point-of-contact service to all employees, their managers and business partners. 
 
Focused on a seamless customer experience and great customer care, the Senior Specialist uses information from multiple systems and resources to respond to inquiries; provides navigational support to employees on self-service/HR tools such as Workday and ServiceNow and routing/escalating inquiries for advanced support. Using the case management system, the Senior Specialist accurately processes, records, closes or escalates transactions in accordance with established service level agreements. This role collects required information or back-up documentation from employees or external customers. This includes tactfully asking customers probing questions to establish context and ensure the solutions offered or the escalation path is appropriate and most likely to succeed. 
 
The Senior Specialist role provides feedback internally, proposing new and effective ways to resolve problems and improve productivity (i.e., continuous improvement efforts), while maintaining broad knowledge of policies, procedures, and resources. 
 
Your Role Accountabilities:

Analyze and resolve different types of requests from employees or clients.
Handle inbound requests via phone, email, the HR-Portal, or other access channels. 
Perform individual employee data transactions and data-entry in Workday and other systems. 
Troubleshoot payroll and time off inquiries, recalculations, employment verifications (VOE/VOIs), direct deposit setups, pay and tax document re-issues, data updates, etc. 
Provide support for self-service and P&C technology tools for employees and customers. 
Ensure completeness of case notes, aligning with company and audit expectations.
Assisting customers to increase awareness of self-service resources and promote self-sufficiency. 
Ensure confidentiality information when processing transactions and addressing employee inquiries. 
Perform and track administrative (no call) departmental tasks, including report reviewing, data updates, mailing, filing, sending correspondence, and records management. 

 
Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in human resources or related field
Fluent in English 
Experience with Human Resources administrative or related experience required, preferably with supervisory responsibilities from a global entertainment environment.
Must be able to maintain confidentiality and use confidential information appropriately.




How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, union status, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

title: CRM Manager - Remote Work
description:
About the job

At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.




Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.




When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.




CRM Manager at BairesDev




In this role, you'll own CRM execution for BairesDev's VIP Audiences & Experiences function, building and automating outreach sequences for our highest-value relationships across existing clients, former clients, and top-tier event audiences. Using Claude as your primary AI tool daily, you'll combine CRM expertise with generative AI fluency and automation workflows to generate measurable sales pipeline. This is an individual-contributor role reporting directly to the Director of VIP Audiences & Experiences, where your work translates directly into meetings booked, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.




What You'll Do:




- Build and execute multi-touch outreach sequences across email, direct mail, and event follow-up for VIP account segments.

- Build and maintain AI-assisted automation workflows connecting outreach, CRM, and data enrichment tools.

- Use Claude as primary AI tool daily for outreach copy, contact research, account intelligence, and workflow logic.

- Track and report on pipeline outcomes including meetings booked, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.

- Own data enrichment workflows, keeping VIP contact records accurate, current, and actionable.




What we are looking for:




- 5+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or outbound marketing.

- In-house experience at a US-based B2B company; agency or contractor work does not qualify.

- B2B SaaS or tech services industry experience.

- Hands-on experience with outreach automation platforms such as Apollo, Clay, Lemlist, Reply.io, or equivalent.

- Daily, hands-on use of generative AI and LLM tools, with Claude strongly preferred; prompt engineering skills required.

- Experience with automation workflows using Zapier, n8n, or Make.com.

- Proficiency in a CRM platform such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or equivalent.

- STEM or quantitative degree in Engineering, Math, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or Physics; strong non-STEM candidates with a demonstrable data or numbers track record also considered.

- Advanced proficiency in English.




Nice to have:




- Experience in B2B tech services, staffing, or nearshore companies.

- Experience marketing to C-suite or VP-level audiences.

- Background in marketing analytics, copywriting, or growth marketing.

- Proficiency in Google Sheets.




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.




Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

- Elaboración de reportes claros y detallados en inglés para clientes y equipo interno

Requisitos:

-Persuasión y orientacion a resultados

-Experiencia gestionando y dando soporte a campañas de publicidad digital (Meta Ads, Google Ads, etc.), incluyendo configuración básica, monitoreo de resultados y ajustes según sea necesario
