title: CRM Manager - Remote Work
description:
About the job

At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.




Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.




When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.




CRM Manager at BairesDev




In this role, you'll own CRM execution for BairesDev's VIP Audiences & Experiences function, building and automating outreach sequences for our highest-value relationships across existing clients, former clients, and top-tier event audiences. Using Claude as your primary AI tool daily, you'll combine CRM expertise with generative AI fluency and automation workflows to generate measurable sales pipeline. This is an individual-contributor role reporting directly to the Director of VIP Audiences & Experiences, where your work translates directly into meetings booked, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.




What You'll Do:




- Build and execute multi-touch outreach sequences across email, direct mail, and event follow-up for VIP account segments.

- Build and maintain AI-assisted automation workflows connecting outreach, CRM, and data enrichment tools.

- Use Claude as primary AI tool daily for outreach copy, contact research, account intelligence, and workflow logic.

- Track and report on pipeline outcomes including meetings booked, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.

- Own data enrichment workflows, keeping VIP contact records accurate, current, and actionable.




What we are looking for:




- 5+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or outbound marketing.

- In-house experience at a US-based B2B company; agency or contractor work does not qualify.

- B2B SaaS or tech services industry experience.

- Hands-on experience with outreach automation platforms such as Apollo, Clay, Lemlist, Reply.io, or equivalent.

- Daily, hands-on use of generative AI and LLM tools, with Claude strongly preferred; prompt engineering skills required.

- Experience with automation workflows using Zapier, n8n, or Make.com.

- Proficiency in a CRM platform such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or equivalent.

- STEM or quantitative degree in Engineering, Math, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or Physics; strong non-STEM candidates with a demonstrable data or numbers track record also considered.

- Advanced proficiency in English.




Nice to have:




- Experience in B2B tech services, staffing, or nearshore companies.

- Experience marketing to C-suite or VP-level audiences.

- Background in marketing analytics, copywriting, or growth marketing.

- Proficiency in Google Sheets.




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.




Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

title: SEO/GEO Program Lead (Senior)
description:
About the job

𝗦𝗘𝗢 & 𝗚𝗘𝗢 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗴𝗿𝗮𝗺 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗱 (𝗦𝗲𝗻𝗶𝗼𝗿) - Salud Digital • Remoto • LATAM/México




𝗞𝗮𝘃𝗿𝗲𝗻 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗼𝗹𝗼𝗴𝗶𝗲𝘀 • Contratista independiente • Tiempo completo




𝗤𝘂𝗶é𝗻𝗲𝘀 𝘀𝗼𝗺𝗼𝘀

Una empresa estadounidense de tecnologia en salud. Operamos una plataforma de telesalud nacional y una clinica de atencion primaria en Miami. Hoy, ninguna de las dos aparece en las busquedas de Google que importan. Una tiene autoridad de dominio 2. La otra tiene 9.




No estamos buscando a alguien que "haga SEO". Buscamos a la persona que va a construir el programa completo desde cero y ser dueña del resultado.




⭐ 𝗤𝘂é 𝘃𝗮𝘀 𝗮 𝗵𝗮𝗰𝗲𝗿 

• Ser dueño del programa de busqueda de dos marcas: una nacional de telesalud, una local de atencion medica en Miami

• Mapear palabras clave a paginas y definir la arquitectura de URLs de ambos sitios

• Escribir los briefs que guian al equipo de contenido — tu decides que se escribe y por que

• Traducir requerimientos de busqueda en tickets tecnicos: hreflang para el split espanol/ingles, schema, canonicals, una URL indexable por servicio

• Dirigir la estrategia de GEO: optimizacion para ChatGPT, Gemini y Google AI Overviews. Bloques de preguntas y respuestas, consistencia de entidad, datos estructurados

• Cargar y mantener el seguimiento de posiciones. Reportar movimiento mensual con numeros

• Dirigir el programa de adquisicion de enlaces hacia una meta definida de dominios de referencia




𝗤𝘂é 𝗻𝗲𝗰𝗲𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘀

✓ 5+ años en SEO, con al menos un programa que hayas construido desde cero y llevado a resultados medibles. Vamos a pedirte los numeros

✓ Experiencia con SEO local (Google Business Profile, citaciones, reseñas) y con SEO nacional de intención comercial. Necesitamos las dos

✓ Manejo de Semrush o Ahrefs a nivel profesional

✓ Entender la diferencia entre optimizar para Google y optimizar para motores de respuesta con IA — y poder explicarla

✓ Español nativo. Inglés a nivel de lectura técnica mínimo

✓ Disponibilidad durante horario laboral del Este de EE. UU. para videollamadas.




✅ 𝗦𝘂𝗺𝗮 𝗺𝘂𝗰𝗵𝗼

→ Experiencia en salud, farmaceutica o industrias reguladas

→ Experiencia con contenido en espanol para el mercado hispano de EE. UU.

→ Haber trabajado con equipos de desarrollo, no solo con agencias




🤝 𝗤𝘂é 𝗼𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗲𝗺𝗼𝘀

✓ MEXICO: USD $2,800 - 3,200 mensuales, pagados contra factura

✓ Tarifa en el rango mas alto del mercado regional. Pagamos bien y esperamos el resultado

✓ Propiedad real: eres la primera contratacion de este programa, no la quinta. Las decisiones son tuyas

✓ Una metrica clara y datos limpios para trabajar. Ya tenemos la investigacion hecha — 56 palabras clave priorizadas, analisis competitivo y linea base de visibilidad en IA para ambas marcas




🎯 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝗮 𝗮𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗿

Mándanos dos cosas. En corto — no queremos una carta de presentación.

About the job

Atención: Esta es una asociación basada 100% en rendimiento (revenue share). NO es un puesto con sueldo fijo ni un contrato de empleo tradicional.




Si generas tráfico, compras pauta publicitaria o construyes audiencias, ya sabes por qué fallan los programas de afiliados SaaS tradicionales: las cookies de 30 días caducan. Envías un prospecto de alta calidad, compra su suscripción 40 días después y tú pierdes la comisión.




adCasa Partner Network opera con una arquitectura distinta. No dependemos de cookies de navegador. Registramos tus referidos directamente en nuestra base de datos. Si tu prospecto compra su suscripción dentro de un año, tú cobras.




EL PRODUCTO (Lo que vendes):

Los programadores tienen VS Code. Los especialistas en marketing tienen 40 pestañas abiertas en el navegador y herramientas desconectadas.




adCasa es un AI Marketing OS diseñado para resolver esto. Reemplazamos hojas de cálculo caóticas y herramientas aisladas con un solo espacio de trabajo. El sistema corrige el doble conteo aplicando modelos matemáticos bayesianos para calcular el ROI real en Google, Meta, LinkedIn y OpenAI Ads (ChatGPT). Detecta fugas de presupuesto, prepara correcciones de campaña y espera a que el operador haga clic en aprobar.




Estrategia humana. Velocidad de máquina.




MODELO DE INGRESOS:

El Cazador: 50% de comisión directa en la primera suscripción o paquete de créditos.
El Agricultor: 10% de comisión recurrente de por vida en todas las renovaciones futuras.
La Red: Gana 3% sobre las ventas de los socios que reclutes, y 2% sobre las ventas que generen los socios de ellos.




INFRAESTRUCTURA:

Pagos automáticos: Sistema bancario de confianza cero. Tras un periodo de retención de 30 días, las comisiones aprobadas se transfieren automáticamente a tu cuenta bancaria todos los miércoles mediante Stripe.




Terminal de recursos: Olvídate de empezar desde cero. Tu panel de control incluye videos listos para publicar, textos para redes sociales y correos electrónicos. Solo agrega tu etiqueta de seguimiento y distribuye.

Media buyers, especialistas en performance marketing y dueños de agencias B2B.

Creadores de contenido, afiliados y operadores de crecimiento.

Cualquier persona lista para presentar material de marketing prediseñado ante dueños de empresas.




CÓMO EMPEZAR AHORA MISMO:

Sin entrevistas, sin tarifas y sin tiempos de espera.

1. Ve a https://adcasa.io/affiliate y crea una cuenta gratuita.

2. Abre el panel de Socios dentro de la aplicación.

3. Conecta tu cuenta bancaria de forma segura mediante Stripe Connect.

4. Copia tu enlace personalizado, toma los videos listos para publicar y empieza a compartir de inmediato.

We want someone who can take an idea and turn it into something real. You should be comfortable researching a topic, creating the content and visuals, publishing or launching the work, measuring the results, and improving the next iteration.

AI should already be a natural part of that process for you.

At the same time, we are not looking for someone who simply generates content and publishes it. Strong judgment, creativity, attention to quality, and an understanding of the audience are essential.

Why Join Azumo?

Azumo offers an opportunity to build your marketing career inside a technology company where AI is part of the everyday work.

You will have the opportunity to:


Access leading paid AI, marketing, analytics, content, and creative tools
Work across social media, content, analytics, GEO/AEO, and emerging AI marketing channels
Experiment with new tools and approaches in real marketing initiatives
Focus on growing one company and one brand: Azumo
Work closely with experienced team members and company leadership
Take ownership of projects and see the direct impact of your work
Receive training and mentored career development
Develop skills in emerging areas of marketing as AI changes how people search, discover, and evaluate companies


Responsibilities

As part of the Azumo marketing team, you will:


Use ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools daily for research, content creation, creative development, analysis, and marketing operations
Create and repurpose content for LinkedIn and other social media channels, including posts, graphics, carousels, and short-form content
Create AI-generated images, videos, and other visual content using modern AI creative tools
Develop and improve articles, case studies, newsletters, presentations, one-pagers, landing pages, and other marketing assets
Implement GEO and AEO strategies to improve Azumo's visibility in AI-powered search platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity
Monitor how Azumo and its competitors appear across traditional and AI search, identify content gaps, and turn those insights into actionable content improvements
Use AI and analytics tools to build recurring reports covering traffic, social media, campaigns, leads, conversions, AI search visibility, and other relevant marketing KPIs
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive marketing tasks and improve existing workflows
Help maintain and update Azumo's website when needed
Support other marketing initiatives in collaboration with the marketing, sales, and leadership teams


About Azumo

Based in San Francisco, California, Azumo is a software development company helping organizations build intelligent applications using modern technologies in AI, data, cloud, web, and mobile.

We work with organizations around the world and believe that great talent can come from anywhere.

If you are excited about marketing, already use AI as part of how you work, and want the opportunity to learn quickly and have a measurable impact on a growing technology company, we'd like to hear from you.

Requirements

Mandatory Qualifications

Expert-level English proficiency, both written and conversational


Strong, well-rounded understanding of marketing language, principles and strategy
Demonstrated ability to connect marketing activities to business objectives and understand how different marketing channels work together
Demonstrable experience using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar generative AI tools for research, content creation, design, video production, analysis and marketing operations. 
Experience creating content for LinkedIn and other social media channels, such as Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, Reddit, or similar platforms
Understanding of GEO, AEO, SEO, and AI search visibility
Comfortable working with marketing data, KPIs, reporting, and performance analysis
Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and take ownership of projects in a remote environment
Strong judgment, creativity, attention to detail, and the ability to improve AI-generated work before publication
Ability to evaluate marketing ideas critically and distinguish between activity, engagement, and meaningful business impact


Other Qualifications


Working experience with HubSpot Marketing Hub
Experience with paid advertising, including Google Ads, Meta Ads, Bing Ads, or emerging AI advertising platforms
Experience with Webflow or a similar website content management system
Experience with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Webmaster Tools and similar analytics platforms
Experience creating AI-assisted workflows or marketing automations


Benefits

The AI-Powered Marketing Specialist will work remotely. Compensation will be commensurate with experience and candidate potential.

Company benefits include:


Paid time off
100% remote-first culture (work anywhere in Latin America)
U.S. Holidays
Training
Mentored career development
USD remuneration
Profit Share Program
Access to premium AI and marketing tools
Maternity coverage


At Azumo, we strive for excellence and strongly believe in professional and personal growth. We want each individual to be successful and aim to help each person achieve their goals while at Azumo and beyond.

Misión Del Cargo

Identificación del proceso contable de importaciones para reconocer los gastos de importación que incurren en la compra de mercancía.

Funciones Del Cargo

¡Queremos formar parte de tu vida! como Especialista ContralorÍa Operativa / Control de Inventarios te encargarás de las siguientes actividades:

Evaluarás los riesgos operativos y contables, asi como asegurar el cumplimiento del proceso de importación ante la autoridad del país.

Te encargarás de controlar, revisar y analizar la eficiencia de los procesos operativos para la administración y seguimiento de los pedidos de importación.

Garantizarás el correcto registro de los pedidos en los sistemas contables.

Gestionarás la integridad de los pedidos de importación, analizando desviaciones en los tiempos de vigencia mediante los movimientos de inventario y estatus logísticos en sistema de SAP ECC.

Garantizarás el correcto registro de los gastos y las estimaciones de los pedidos de importación, asegurando la utilidad de estos.

Asegurarás la integridad, exactitud y confiabilidad de la información financiera, detectando de manera oportuna discrepancias, omisiones o registros duplicados que puedan afectar la toma de decisiones.

Reportarás la eficiencia de los procesos logísticos para la administración y seguimiento de los movimientos de inventario en sistema y operativos en la bodega para la gestión de los pedidos de importación.

Lugar de trabajo: Santa Fe.
